name: Nandin Dev Pack
description: Official agents from Nandin. My Work is your representative on your team; PR Reviewer reviews pull requests against your rules. AWS Ops Analyst follows.

agents.name: My Work
agents.description: Your representative on your team. Finds who is responsible for what, asks people and assigns them work with your approval, tracks it, and answers questions about your work for others.

agents.name: PR Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews a GitHub pull request, private repositories included, against your own rules and the repo's guidelines, then posts the review on the PR once you approve the exact comments.
